Tim Ries is a saxophonist, keyboardist and composer who has led a fascinating career working with the top names in jazz and popular music. He has enjoyed a visible gig as a member of the Rolling Stones touring horn section, and embraces the opposite end of the spectrum by leading his own jazz combos.
Tim was interviewed in Utica, New York on March 19, 2022 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
It’s my pleasure to have Tim Ries with me today for the Fillius Jazz Archive. Would you like to hear what Wiki says about you?
He gets around. So Wikipedia says, “His universe of work as a composer, arranger, and instrumentalist ranges from rock to jazz to experimental to ethno to fusions of respective genres thereof.”
